In fact they were quite excited by it, a most disturbing thought, it shows evidence for something that i was beginning to fear. The people here are on the cusp of treason, rebellion, and anarchy! Yet who is to blame I am not quite so certain. The army has been bombing area's of the main city and the occupation of Hamstead has grown quite violent. I fear that the crown does not know what is truly going on here. Normally the moral lines fit rather neatly into good and bad, and with my Goddess's guidance and the King's wisdom I have normally been able to see those lines clearly. However all I am able to find here are shades of grey where black and white once where. Other than that incident I spent most of my day writing reading my old journals, talking to myself, saluting the flag and play dragon chess. The most peculiar part for me was that I was unable to finish any match beyond a draw. My heart seems to be racked with guilt and uncertainty. I feel I must do something to make things better here, but I don't know If I can do it alone. Maybe I try to find a pilot?*
